item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CHAOS-R
  • 発売日: 2024-01-26
  • スコア: 6.39/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 蟲の王～全テノ雌ハ我ガ子孫ノ苗床～
  • 英語名: Mushi no Ou Subete no Mesu wa Waga Shison no Naedoko

あらすじ

Humans and insects had been avoiding conflict by not encroaching on each other’s territory. As a result, the insects had been sharing some of the benefits born from the deep forest with humans. However, a little over a decade ago, humanity stole “power” from the Insect King and sealed him deep within the forest. With the power gained from the insects, humans increased their national strength, eventually forgetting their fear and reverence for the forest, instead encroaching upon it. Then one day, adventurers exploring the depths of the forest were violated and brutally murdered, sparking the beginning of a series of events.

At some point, the Tentacle Princess, Altea, began ruling the world, spreading terror and despair.

あらすじ

・Clouded Bitch Princess ～Pound Your Big One into Me Relentlessly～

In a devastated world lies a haven, once a grand shopping mall boasting of its prosperity. A girl appears in this relatively safe zone, seeking help and shelter from the outlaws roaming the wastelands. However, her arrival also marks the beginning of the paradise’s downfall. Men, who had been collaborating for survival, slowly began to turn against each other, influenced by the presence of this single girl.

item.title: Jain no Ikenie ~Shokushu-hime Altea & Mashikyuu Tsukai Bianka Owari no Nai Jutai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CHAOS-R
  • 発売日: 2018-06-29
  • スコア: 6.3/10 (121 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 邪淫のいけにえ ～触手姫アルテア＆魔子宮遣いビアンカ 終わりの無い受胎～
  • 英語名: Jain no Ikenie Shokushu-hime Altea & Mashikyuu Tsukai Bianka Owari no Nai Jutai

あらすじ

A collection of two Chaos-R games based in the same universe, bundled together for an international release: Tentacle Princess Altea and Saint Bianca’s Ceaseless Conception!

With her golden blond hair and sapphire blue eyes, Princess Altea is known across the land for her extraordinary beauty. However, to end the terrible drought that has ravaged her beloved Kingdom of Aquila, she is sacrificed to the sorcerer Aldebaran. Upon arrival to Aldebaran’s mansion she meets Deneb Swan, another sacrificed princess. Together, they work together to escape the wicked sorcerer and regain their freedom.
